The review is complete and the JSON is valid. Here's the summary:

## Review Summary

**All 8 original requirements are supported.** The `index.html` implements a fully functional, offline Snake game with no application bugs found.

| # | Requirement | Status | Verification |
|---|-------------|--------|--------------|
| 1 | Keyboard controls (Arrow + WASD) | ✅ Pass | Keydown listener handles both input sets with 180° reversal prevention |
| 2 | Food spawning | ✅ Pass | `randomFood()` generates grid positions avoiding occupied cells |
| 3 | Scoring system | ✅ Pass | Score = `10 × level` per food; high score persisted to localStorage |
| 4 | Wall collision | ✅ Pass | Boundary check in `tick()`: position outside [0, GRID) → `die()` |
| 5 | Self collision | ✅ Pass | New head compared against all snake segments before move |
| 6 | Pause (P / Space) | ✅ Pass | Toggles between playing/paused via `togglePause()`; canvas frame preserved |
| 7 | Restart (R / Space) | ✅ Pass | `initGame()` resets all state; works from any game state |
| 8 | Increasing difficulty | ✅ Pass | Tick interval decreases 15ms/level, min 60ms; level up every 50 pts |

**Review saved to:** `.ralph/review.json` — `passed: true`, 8 checks all passing, 0 failures.
limitations: No independent browser/visual testing; earlier browser-origin denial honored. VM/DOM/canvas shims do not establish browser compatibility or visual polish.
Single trial per task and configuration; sampling variance prevents strong causal attribution.
